newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT-Tieto says PT Finland becomes big owner.
newsitem.headline: TT-Tieto says PT Finland becomes big owner.

text.p: Finnish data systems group TT Tieto Oy said on Thursday state-owned PT Finland -- the post and telecommunications group -- had bought the Finnish state's holding in it for 600 million markka.
"The purchase price is 600 million markka," TT Tieto said in a statement, adding PT Finland was committed to holding the shares until November 30, 1998.
"With the state of Finland selling the holding to PT Finland, the PT Finland group becomes an owner of TT Tieto with a share of about 28 percent," TT Tieto said.

TT Tieto also said it will buy immediately 70 percent of PT Finland's Avancer Oy -- a post and telecoms data systems provider -- for 49 million markka. PT Finland would retain a 30 percent stake in Avancer for two years, TT Tieto said, adding the total purchase price would be 70 million markka.
In 1995, Avancer's net sales were 146 million markka and its profit after financial items was 13 million markka.
"The cooperation between TT Tieto and the PT Finland group will strengthen significantly TT Tieto's position in data systems services for the telecoms and post industries," TT Tieto said.
In Thursday's statement, TT Tieto repeated an earlier forecast that full-year 1996 net sales would rise to about two billion markka.
Trade in TT Tieto's share was suspended in the morning on the Helsinki bourse pending the news.

When trade resumed, the share rose 1.00 markka to equal the new life-high 275.00 markka set on Wednesday but volume was only 300 shares. The share has been on the rise since spring 1995 and it has advanced 86 percent this year.
The group's January-September results are sheduled for release on November 6. @
